newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Berkshire's Tranz Rail stake down to 5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Berkshire's Tranz Rail stake down to 5 pct.

text.p: U.S. Investment fund Berkshire Fund III said on Friday its recent offering of a 7.8 percent stake in Tranz Rail has reduced its holding to 4.99 percent.

The company offered 9.8 million shares in an international offer through the US market, and had subsequently sold a further 1.5 million shares to the offer underwriters through an over-allotment provision.

In a substantial security holder notice, Berkshire said its holding was now down to 4.99 percent, from a relevant interest of 64 percent. The company previously held rights over the shares of the company's other major shareholders, Wisconsin Central Transportation Corp and Fay Richwhite associate Pacific Rail.
American depositary receipts of three Tranz Rail shares sold for $US18 ($NZ26) each.
